comments.excerpt: Chat hybrid · RRF · rerank-3-lite threshold 0.40 What does RRF stand for and how does it fuse the two ranked lists? ANSWER · GROUNDED RRF stands for Reciprocal Rank Fusion. Each document earns a contribution of 1 / (k + rank) from every list it appears in, where k is a damping constant, typically 60
